task_description: Build a complete ICT (Inner Circle Trader) trading bot for NAS100/US100 using Python and MetaTrader 5. Implements modular ICT concepts (market structure, order blocks, FVG, liquidity sweeps, kill zones, OTE, premium/discount), a sequential confirmation entry model, risk management, backtesting, Telegram notifications, and trade logging.
